meta_description:
1M likes, 8,909 comments - discussingfilm on August 8, 2026: "Exclusive first look images of Mahesh Babu as Rudhra in S.S. Rajamouli’s #Varanasi

“Rudhra was born to fulfil a purpose much larger than himself. He carries a destiny he did not ask for. He is witty, he is vulnerable, and he is fierce. That is what Mahesh brought to him. Anyone can play fierce. Very few can play fierce and fragile in the same breath.

“These frames are from our Africa schedule, and the land gave us something no set could. Shooting around Kilimanjaro and in the Masai Mara, I was stunned. There were mornings I felt even the 1.43:1 IMAX frame could not hold what was in front of us.”".
